name: karyo
description: Visual docs where the code describes itself: a local web view of your project's Karyo model and explainers (Bench, theater, Splice), the karyo CLI, the karyo-explain and docket skills, a built-in demo (/karyo:demo), explainers kept current in Claude artifacts (/karyo:artifact), the Karyo MCP server, and Jarvis voice mode. Works in Claude Code, Claude Desktop and Cowork with nothing to install by hand.
